newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers, Warner no comment on Sanofi.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers, Warner no comment on Sanofi.

text.p: Spokesmen at U.S. pharmaceutical companies Bristol-Myers Squibb Co and Warner-Lambert Co had no comment on market talk on Thursday that mentioned them as possible bidders for France's Sanofi.
Earlier French oil company Elf Aquitaine, the majority owner of Sanofi, said it wanted the unit to find a merger partner to boost its profitability, but said no talks were underway yet.
Traders and analysts in Paris listed Bristol-Myers, which has been working with Sanofi in the development and marketing of some drugs since 1993, and Warner-Lambert, as among potential bidders.
The spokesmen for both Bristol-Myers and Warner-Lambert cited company policies not to comment on market rumors or speculation.
